item.title: After bankruptcy, he was banned from sports betting sites. Then he discovered Kalshi
item.description: The dark side of the prediction market boom is becoming more clear: Experts say the sites have become go-to outlets for gambling addicts to relapse as the companies avoid state consumer protections.

item.title: Former federal regulator says existing laws already apply to AI
item.description: NPR's Juana Summers talks with Lina Khan, chair of the Federal Trade Commission in the Biden administration, about her op-ed "There Are Plenty of Laws on the Books to Check the A.I. Giants. Use Them."

item.title: Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space
item.description: The fridge-size satellite with AI chips on board is part of Project Suncatcher, the company's moonshot effort to put AI data centers in space and harness solar energy.
